Messages.Author: hamd...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Compel the Spirit

Type: Action
Blood Cost: 1

Prerequisite: necromancy

Card Text:

+1 stealth action. Only usable if a retainer or ally you control has
been burned since your last turn. Move the card from your ash heap to
your hand.

SUP: As above, but you may move the ally or retainer to the active
region without paying the cost to put him or her in play. If a retainer
is chosen, he or she must be placed on the acting minion.

Does "...since your last turn..." also mean this card can be played
_during_ your turn if an ally has been burned?

e.g. During my minion phase, Abrosius the Ferryman with Talbots
Chainsaw rushes a Gangrel and falls afoul of some Wolf Claws and Undead
Strength. A Giovanni with superior Necromacy plays Compel the Spirit to
bring him (but not the chainsaw) back.

Is this legit? It has happened since my last turn!

DH

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
